title: Qt: Copy as HTML for Logray
description:
This feature adds the same functionality introduced last week for Wireshark UI. Refer to MR: https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/17158 Refer to Commit: https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/commit/f40e86bc

Hello @johnthacker - I have added the missing piece to Logray as well. Thanks for bringing it to my notice.

P.S.

I was not aware of Logray until I read [From Network Packets to Log Data: How Logray built upon Falco’s foundation | The Official Wireshark Blog](https://blog.wireshark.org/2024/01/from-network-packets-to-log-data-how-logray-built-upon-falcos-foundation/)
